overview: The School Committee approved a $22.7 million schematic design for Roberts Elementary renovations and reallocated capital funds for various maintenance projects. The committee also updated its operating rules, honored a long-serving administrator upon retirement, and adopted several resolutions regarding school safety and federal funding.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including a $35,000 donation from the Cummings Foundation and meeting minutes amended to clarify sustainability goals for the high school project.

items.title: Recognition of Joan Bowen
items.summary: The committee and administration honored Director of Student Services Joan Bowen for her 33 years of service to the district upon her retirement.

items.title: MPS Wellness Policy
items.summary: Approved the updated district wellness policy following a presentation on nutrition, physical activity, and social-emotional health standards required for state compliance.

items.title: Roberts Elementary HVAC and Roof Schematic Design
items.summary: Approved the $22.7 million schematic design for HVAC electrification and roof replacement at Roberts Elementary School, which is eligible for a 53.32% reimbursement rate from the MSBA.

items.title: FY27 Capital Projects Adjustments
items.summary: Reallocated approximately $460,000 in unused capital and supplemental state funds toward school intercom systems, chiller repairs, turf improvements, and hot water tank replacements.

items.title: Resolution 2026-06: School Committee Rules
items.summary: Approved updated operating rules for the School Committee reflecting edits discussed in previous meetings.

items.title: Resolution 2026-20: Assessment Landscape Report
items.summary: Referred a review of district-wide student testing and preparation schedules to the Subcommittee for Curriculum and Instruction.

items.title: Resolution 2026-21: E-Bike Safety Education
items.summary: Approved a resolution to provide educational materials to students and families regarding the laws and safety practices for e-bikes and other micromobility devices.

items.title: Resolution 2026-22: MCHS Building Committee Membership
items.summary: Updated the membership of the Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee for the schematic design phase, appointing several new voting and non-voting members.

items.title: Resolution 2026-23: Support of the E-Rate Program
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging the FCC to preserve and fully fund the E-Rate program, which provides approximately $278,000 in annual technology and broadband discounts to the district.
